purpose: Measure 0-to-8k and 8k-to-40k net success changes and three-timepoint case trajectories; not selector validation
authorization: User endorsed B intermediate-policy evaluation following A review; C and original stages 2/3 held

evaluation.recovery: Immutable attempts. Fail closed on integrity or numerical failure; no scientific-effect stopping.

budget.technical_evaluation: Known final BP policy 41011/4201, first two cases per task, compared exactly to recorded results; full-state restoration and evaluation invariance
budget.retry_steps: No automatic retries or budget expansion; partial outputs and actual consumed steps retained
budget.accounting: B O100 is research measurement, not a paid 4k online diagnosis. Compare learned 8k and 40k; no 36k evaluation in this scope.

analysis.independent_unit: five original parents; average the two paths within each parent

contrasts.stop8_advantage: J8-J40; negative of late, not a separate tested contrast

analysis.denominators: 100 cases for each task, 400 for macro; conditional rates are NA for empty denominators
analysis.primary_reporting: All ten paths, five parent means, task scores, fixed J0/J8/J40 means and full parent-removal means; all patterns

case_uncertainty.pairing: One case resample per parent and task applied to original parent and both paths' 8k and 40k outcomes; independent across parent/task strata
case_uncertainty.order: parents ascending, tasks DO/DC/PU/BP; per-stratum 20000x100 integer indices
case_uncertainty.simultaneous_family: 30 path macro contrasts: 5 parents x 2 paths x early/late/total
case_uncertainty.intervals: marginal percentile95 and max-absolute-standardized-deviation simultaneous95; SD uses ddof=1; linear quantiles
case_uncertainty.zero_SE: Mark empirical degeneracy, exclude from max statistic; do not interpret as population certainty
case_uncertainty.task_and_parent_intervals: Marginal intervals only, descriptive; not added to the prespecified simultaneous family
case_uncertainty.scope: Fitted-policy, empirical evaluation-case uncertainty, not new learning futures

parent_uncertainty.method: Exact enumeration of 5^5=3125 equal-probability parent resamples of paired parent-mean contrasts
parent_uncertainty.intervals: Descriptive percentile95, five-parent sample; distinct from case-bootstrap intervals
parent_uncertainty.sensitivity: Drop each parent and recompute constant-policy means; no rule fitting

development_flags.early_loss_then_recovery: early<=-2 and late>=2; report total separately
development_flags.early_loss_still_below_parent: early<=-2 and total<=-2; may coexist with partial recovery
development_flags.broad_stop8_pattern: at least 8/10 paths have stop8_advantage>=2 and at least 4/5 parents have both paths >=2
development_flags.opposite_repeatable_parent_preferences: one parent has both paths late>=2 and another has both late<=-2
development_flags.case_supported_opposite_preferences: above point pattern and respective simultaneous late intervals exclude zero for both paths in each parent
development_flags.interpretation: Descriptive investment flags may overlap; never significance claims, expected-state-value estimates, automatic gates, or authorization

prohibited_in_this_stage: fit or tune TD or other selector
use outcome O100 as free decision input
claim predictive value from correlation of J8-J0 and J40-J8 sharing J8 noise
infer that avoiding loss preserves all gains
infer exact timing inside 0-8k or 8-40k intervals

future_decisions.early_loss_then_recovery: Weakens stopping at 8k; do not miss later recovery
future_decisions.early_loss_persists: 8k stop does not restore original parent; earlier decision or rollback is a separate proposal
future_decisions.broad_stop8: Evaluate a better constant horizon before claiming state-dependent choice
future_decisions.heterogeneous_late_value: Motivates prefix-only signal development with separate diagnostic/outcome cases and later fresh-future validation; no immediate C
future_decisions.small_or_uncertain: Report limited practical room or unresolved evidence; no automatic seed expansion
future_decisions.default: Finish B, report all results, retain C and original 2/3 holds
